h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: An in-cell identity shortcut around the serial 0-1-2-3 chain eases optimisation of the extra serial depth, so a 3x3 on edge 2 gains more.
When edge 5 already delivers learned 3x3 features to node 3, a pooled 0->3 branch is a smaller share of the output and acts as a harmless smoothed identity.
An identity 0->3 edge preserves the unblurred input at the output, so pooling at the head of the serial chain costs less.
A 3x3 on edge 4 supplies learned features to the output, so downgrading the 2->3 route to a pool hurts less.
Two parallel 3x3 branches summed into the output node show diminishing returns, so the second conv adds less.
An upstream 3x3 on edge 2 already provides spatial context on the 1-2-3 path, so a 1x1 on edge 5 loses less or gains more.
An identity 1->3 forwards node-1 conv features straight to the output, so a 3x3 on edge 0 contributes more.
A conv-headed serial chain is deeper and harder to optimise, so an in-cell residual on 0->3 helps more.
Two parameter-free pooled branches summed at the output over-smooth it, turning a near-neutral edit harmful.
An identity 0->2 acts as a residual around the 0-1-2 conv chain and stabilises its training.
